Level 3: Deals [ 45% + 6% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of target enemy creature’s maximum HP as Magic Damage. Each time this spell is re-cast on the same target, it deals +200% more Damage. This effect is stackable. (Change: Damage per Spell Power: 3% > 6% HP.)
Level 4: Deals [ 45% + 6% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of target enemy creature’s maximum HP as Magic Damage. Each time this spell is re-cast on the same target, it deals +200% more Damage. Black Hole, space magic. Levels: Level 1: Deals [ 80 + 15 × hero’s Spell Power ] Magic Damage to all creatures on the target hex and up to 2 hexes away in every direction. Pulls the furthest affected targets towards the center if possible.

Level 3: Deals [ 200 + 15 × hero’s Spell Power ] Magic Damage to all creatures on the target hex and up to 2 hexes away in every direction. Pulls the furthest affected targets towards the center if possible. (Change: Base Damage: 120 > 200.)
Level 4: Deals [ 200 + 20 × hero’s Spell Power ] Magic Damage to all creatures on the target hex and up to 2 hexes away in every direction. Pulls the furthest affected targets towards the center if possible. (Change: Damage per Spell Power: 15 > 20.)

Doreath's Tide, space magic. Levels: Level 1: All friendly creatures gain 1 Speed and Initiative. All enemies lose 1 Speed and Initiative.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 8 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s).
Level 2: All friendly creatures gain 1 Speed and Initiative. All enemies lose 1 Speed and Initiative.
Duration: [ 2 + 1 per every 8 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Base duration of effect: 1 > 2.)

Energy Explosion, space magic. Levels: Level 1: Deals 30 Magic Damage per Focus Charge to all creatures in one-hex radius.
Level 2: Deals 40 Magic Damage per Focus Charge to all creatures in one-hex radius. (Change: Damage per Focus Charge: 30 > 40.)

Temporal Spheres, space magic. Levels: Level 1: Place up to 2 invisible traps on free hexes. Traps trigger when stepped on by a ground creature, dealing Magic Damage to the creature and adjacent ones before disappearing. The Damage equals [ 100% + 5% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of one unit’s maximum HP.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 5 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s).
Level 2: Place up to 2 invisible traps on free hexes. Traps trigger when stepped on by a ground creature, dealing Magic Damage to the creature and adjacent ones before disappearing. The Damage equals [ 100% + 10% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of one unit’s maximum HP.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 5 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Damage per Spell Power: 5% > 10%.)
Level 3: Place up to 3 invisible traps on free hexes. Traps trigger when stepped on by a ground creature, dealing Magic Damage to the creature and adjacent ones before disappearing. The Damage equals [ 100% + 10% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of one unit’s maximum HP.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 5 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Traps: 2 > 3.)
Level 4: Place up to 3 invisible traps on free hexes. Traps trigger when stepped on by a ground creature, dealing Magic Damage to the creature and adjacent ones before disappearing. The Damage equals [ 100% + 15% × hero’s Spell Power ]% of one unit’s maximum HP.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 5 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Damage per Spell Power: 10% > 15%.)

Spatial Snare, space magic. Levels: Level 1: Place up to 2 invisible trap(s) on free hexes. Traps trigger when a ground creature moves through them, halting its movement, ending its current turn, and canceling its next turn. After triggering, the trap disappears. If the trap is on the last hex of a route, it does not trigger.
However, the trap on the last hex will always trigger if any creature flies, jumps, or teleports onto it, or is forcefully moved there.
Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 7 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s).
Level 2: Place up to 2 invisible trap(s) on free hexes. Traps trigger when a ground creature moves through them, halting its movement, ending its current turn, and canceling its next turn. After triggering, the trap disappears. If the trap is on the last hex of a route, it does not trigger.

Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 7 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Base mana cost: 10 > 5.)
Level 3: Place up to 3 invisible trap(s) on free hexes. Traps trigger when a ground creature moves through them, halting its movement, ending its current turn, and canceling its next turn. After triggering, the trap disappears. If the trap is on the last hex of a route, it does not trigger.

Duration: [ 1 + 1 per every 7 hero’s Spell Power ] round(s). (Change: Traps: 2 > 3.)
